label: Sonoma D22 GPS NTP/PTP time server
description: Fourth-generation Stratum-1 network time server that disciplines from its internal GPS receiver (CDMA or a free-running OCXO/TCXO holdover on other variants) and sustains about 7,500 NTP requests per second with sub-10-microsecond timestamping. Two independent 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 ports on the rear panel, each optionally running PTP/IEEE-1588; the console interface is USB and the timing outputs are BNC.
notes: Datasheet 'Network I/O': two rear-panel RJ-45 jacks, 10/100/1000Base-T Ethernet, ports are independent (separate subnets/isolated networks) and can be licensed for PTP. Sonoma manual lists exactly three interface ports: two Ethernet plus one USB console. 1PPS/10 MHz are BNC.
